steps.en: Clone the repository, install dependencies and start the demo
steps.zh: 克隆仓库、安装依赖并启动演示

steps.en: Open /chart and submit birth date, clock time and gender
steps.zh: 打开排盘页，提交出生日期、时间与性别

steps.en: Convert the demo input and generate a chart locally
steps.zh: 转换演示输入，在本地生成命盘

steps.en: Draw the twelve compartments and selectable star details
steps.zh: 画出十二宫，提供可点选的星曜详情

value.en: Inspect a traditional chart without writing the engine or supplying an AI key
value.zh: 不用重写排盘引擎或提供 AI 密钥，即可查看传统命盘
